name: Shivansh
summary: Software Engineer at HSBC working on HSBCnet, the global corporate banking platform. Primary stack is Java + Spring Boot.

highlights: Building on HSBCnet — HSBC's global corporate banking platform that handles payments and cash management for large enterprise customers. Worked with Java ,Spring boot   Mongo DB , SQL
Migrated the Germany payment corridor from legacy SWIFT MT messages to the ISO 20022 MX standard (pain.001 / pain.002), giving the bank a more structured end-to-end payment flow.

Built features for Move Money, the UI orchestration layer of HSBCnet — rule-based screen rendering, business-driven workflows, BIC code lookups, payload validation, and National Language Support for China payments.
Implemented the SEPA Verification of Payee (VoP) workflow as an event-driven Google Pub/Sub listener that processes beneficiary checks and feeds results into payment decisioning.
Hardened Transaction Service APIs — synced payment data into a shared MongoDB collection, fixed production bugs, upgraded dependencies, and patched security findings.
Migrated backend APIs to Java 17, added automated tests with JUnit and Karate, and used Splunk for log analysis to keep things reliable.
Got the star Performer award in Q2 of 2026
